```{r}
rm(list = ls())
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(vegan)
library(pairwiseAdonis)
load(here("Data", "permanova_matrix_clean.Rdata")) #unscaled matrix
load(here( "Data", "annotation_col.Rdata")) #metadata


df_prep <- as.data.frame(permanova_matrix)

#force every column to be numeric using base R 
clean_df <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_prep, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x))))

#drop any columns that are not numeric
clean_df <- clean_df[, colSums(is.na(clean_df)) < nrow(clean_df), drop = FALSE]

#if any rows still have random missing values, omit them so scale() works
clean_df <- na.omit(clean_df)

#convert to a pure numeric matrix and apply Z-score scaling
final_permanova_matrix <- as.matrix(clean_df)
scaled_permanova_matrix <- scale(final_permanova_matrix)
```
